lead: The value of a field with a fixed set of values (a status, a priority, a plan) as a [Tag](/tag) whose text and colour come from a table. Write the table once for a field and every use is one line, instead of a component per field.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: `options` has every value of the field: its text and colour. The labels are yours, so they follow your language.

variants.title: A look of its own
variants.description: A value can set its `variant` over the tag's: an urgent priority is `solid` while the others are `soft`.

fallback.title: A value that is not in the table
fallback.description: It is shown as it is, in neutral, so a new value on the server does not break the page.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: EnumTag is a Tag and has no slot of its own.
